build_entity_with_plan: build an Entity prefab that creates an agent with situation perception, self perception, and planning components
create_entity_params: create an Entity with custom name, goal, and force_time_horizon parameters for agent configuration
build_agent_with_goal: build an agent using Entity.build with a language model and memory bank that includes an overarching goal
review_entity_components: review the Entity prefab components including instructions, observation, situation perception, self perception, and plan
refactor_entity_params: refactor the Entity params to customize the agent name, goal, or time horizon settings
